name: BTC 12-hour session allocation: short daytime / cash nighttime (08 UTC)
author: Authors of session strategy study

indicators.position choices: cash (0), fixed long (+1), fixed short (-1), lagged momentum, lagged reversal

entry_long: Daytime leg: Always hold -1 during session. Nighttime leg: No position during session.
entry_short: Daytime leg: Always hold -1 during session. Nighttime leg: No position during session.
exit: Position is set for each session; close/recompute at session boundary.
position_sizing: Unit notional per active session leg in the paper framework.
filters: Rule is selected independently for each 12-hour session; momentum and reversal use previous return for that same session.
implementation_notes: This is one of the paper’s 25 non-redundant combinations, not a lookback-parameter variant. The paper evaluates many cutoff hours and reports full-sample selected combinations, creating selection risk. Costs omit venue fees, slippage, funding and taxes.
